title: Mate equality after cancelling the scalar/pullback system isomorphism
statement: After postcomposing both normalized routes with the inverse of the scalar/pullback system isomorphism, the strict quotient square gives equal morphisms. Since this postcomposition is an isomorphism, the target equation follows by cancellation.

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 0941, normalization of the actual completed scalar comparisons.

proof.text: Use the essential surjectivity of the good localization to choose P and eP representing M. Apply the existing coherent primitive reduction presentation theorem to obtain C,eC,kappa,hp,hc, and construct the strict nested quotient isomorphism q.

The scalar cochain counit computes on pull_E(C): transfer levelwise K-flatness and termwise flatness through kappa, use sequence-site detection and preservation under pullback, then invoke scalar-model computability. Thus every factor in the explicit scalarPullbackRoosCoordinate t is invertible.

Cancel postcomposition by t. The left normalization equation identifies the left route followed by t with scalarPullbackRoosChain. On the right, functoriality and the system isomorphism hom_inv_id cancel its adjacent hom and inverse; the right normalization equation identifies the remainder with that same explicit ordinary chain. Transitivity proves the unchanged mate equation. The old tensor/pullback strict-square hypothesis is not needed by this scalar/pullback computation.

proof_origin.place: Whole-system coherent quotient presentation, explicit ordinary scalarPullbackChain, and the two independent normalization calculations. Stacks 06YY, 07A4, 0941; full cancellation is formalized in Lean.

from.place: normalization and total-limit assembly part of original proof step

theorem scalarTowerPullbackLimitSquare_mate (W : Bool → Scheme.{u})
    (ME : CompletedOperations.Models.{u, u} l E W)
    (ML : CompletedOperations.Models.{u, u} l L W)
    (SX : IntegralComparisonScalarModel.{u, u} l E L ι (W true)
      (ME.calculus true) (ML.roos true))
    (SY : IntegralComparisonScalarModel.{u, u} l E L ι (W false)
      (ME.calculus false) (ML.roos false))
    (f : W true ⟶ W false)
    (_hX : IsUnit (l : Γ(W true, ⊤))) (_hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(W false, ⊤)))
    (M : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E (W false))
    (hF : IsSfDerivedComplete l E (W true)
      ((integralDerivedPullback.{u, u} l E f).obj M.obj))
    (_hstrict : leftRoute l E L ι f = rightRoute l E L ι f) :
    ((scalarPullbackCompleted l E L ι f M.obj M.property.1 hF).hom ≫
        (ML.pullback f).realization.hom.app
          ((integralScalarExtension.{u} l E L ι (W false)).obj M.obj) ≫
        (coefficientSequenceLimit.{u, u} l L (W true)).map
          ((integralComparisonDerivedSequencePullback.{u, u} l L f).map
            (scalarReduction l E L ι (W false) (ME.calculus false) (ML.calculus false)
              (ML.roos false) SY M.obj)) ≫
      (coefficientSequenceLimit.{u, u} l L (W true)).map
        ((integralComparisonSystemScalarPullback.{u, u} l E L ι f).inv.app
          ((ME.calculus false).reduction.obj M.obj))) =
    (SX.realization.hom.app ((integralDerivedPullback.{u, u} l E f).obj M.obj) ≫
        (coefficientSequenceLimit.{u, u} l L (W true)).map
          ((integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar.{u, u} l E L ι (W true)).map
            (pullbackReduction l E W ME f M.obj) ≫
          (integralComparisonSystemScalarPullback.{u, u} l E L ι f).hom.app
            ((ME.calculus false).reduction.obj M.obj))) ≫
      (coefficientSequenceLimit.{u, u} l L (W true)).map
        ((integralComparisonSystemScalarPullback.{u, u} l E L ι f).inv.app
          ((ME.calculus false).reduction.obj M.obj))
